Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
import uu, pathlib, binascii, struct, zlib, io
src='libarchive/libarchive/test/test_read_format_rar5_owner.rar.uu'
out='/tmp/owner.rar'
uu.decode(src,out,quiet=True)
b=pathlib.Path(out).read_bytes()
print(len(b), b[:80].hex())
print(b[:8])

def read_var(buf, off):
    res=0; shift=0
    for i in range(8):
        bb=buf[off+i]
        res += (bb & 0x7f) << shift
        if (bb & 0x80)==0:
            return res, i+1
        shift += 7
    bb=buf[off+8]
    res += (bb & 0x7f) << shift
    return res,9

o=8
n=0
while o < len(b):
    if o+4>len(b): break
    crc=struct.unpack_from('<I',b,o)[0]
    raw, l=read_var(b,o+4)
    hstart=o+4
    hdr_size=raw+l
    hdr=b[hstart:hstart+hdr_size]
    comp=zlib.crc32(hdr)&0xffffffff
    print('\nblock',n,'off',o,'crc',hex(crc),'comp',hex(comp),'raw',raw,'lenvar',l,'hdr_size',hdr_size,'hdr',hdr.hex())
    p=o+4+l
    hid,hl=read_var(b,p); p+=hl
    flags,fl=read_var(b,p); p+=fl
    print(' id',hid,'flags',hex(flags),'after header fields rel',p-o)
    # parse file/main roughly
    if hid==1:
        if flags&1:
            ed,el=read_var(b,p); p+=el; print(' main extra_data_size',ed)
        af,al=read_var(b,p); p+=al; print(' archive_flags',af,'payload',b[p:o+4+hdr_size].hex())
    if hid in (2,3):
        if flags&1:
            ed,el=read_var(b,p); p+=el; print(' extra_data_size',ed)
        if flags&2:
            ds,dl=read_var(b,p); p+=dl; print(' data_size',ds)
        vals=[]
        for name in ['file_flags','unpacked_size','file_attr','compression_info','host_os','name_size']:
            v,vl=read_var(b,p); p+=vl; vals.append((name,v,vl))
        print(vals,'name',b[p:p+vals[-1][1]],'p',p)
        p+=vals[-1][1]
        endhdr=o+4+hdr_size
        print('extra bytes rel',p-o,'to endhdr',endhdr-o,b[p:endhdr].hex())
        q=p
        rem=ed if flags&1 else 0
        while q<endhdr:
            fs,fsl=read_var(b,q); q+=fsl
            fid,fil=read_var(b,q); q+=fil
            print('  extra field size',fs,'id',fid,'qrel',q-o,'body',b[q:min(endhdr,q+fs)].hex())
            q+=fs # maybe size excludes size/id? unclear
    o = o+4+hdr_size
    # skip data maybe for file block data_size
    if 'ds' in locals() and hid in (2,3):
        o += ds
        del ds
    n+=1
PY
